confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on a few aggregated cost-of-living sources and hotel and venue menus from 2021 to 2025, plus a French price-comparison site and rough community estimates. Hotel menus add 10% service and 7% tax, which pushes some drink prices up, so I used local-venue levels. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker and were set from the beer and hotel-menu relationship (hotel cocktails and wines around THB 260-390 per drink). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Hua Hin resort-town context. I did not inspect live booking pages or current listings and did not search for accommodation prices. The FX observation is the RBA's latest figure found on 2026-11-19, though the lookup was not a direct read of the F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is Thai beach and resort towns and mid-sized Thai tourist cities (such as Chiang Mai and Pattaya), using Thai cost-of-living aggregates for Bangkok and Chiang Mai as a floor and hotel menus in Hua Hin as a ceiling for drinks. Accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of Hua Hin's mix of guesthouses, hostels and 3-star resort hotels, not from any listing.
